recipes.name: Salty Sesame and Dark Chocolate Chip Cookies
Egg Cream Carbonated Milk & Dark Chocolate Drops
recipes.notes: Soft tender milk cookie base infused with dark chocolate syrup, malt, and cold club soda for an airy egg cream lift. Fold in chilled seltzer right before portioning. Bake 10-12 min. (From the Retro Soda Fountain Cookies Master Plan; base batch = 24 cookies.)

recipes.name: Coca-Cola Molasses Crinkle Cookies
recipes.notes: Reduce 2 L Mexican Coke to 1.5 cups of syrup (4x) and use it in place of molasses. Roll 1.5-inch balls in sugar; bake 8-10 min. (From the Retro Soda Fountain Cookies Master Plan; base batch = 24 cookies.)

recipes.name: Orange Creamsicle Drops
recipes.notes: Rub orange zest into the sugars; fold in white chocolate chips. Bake 10-12 min at 350°F until edges are light golden; drizzle with orange-vanilla glaze once cool. (From the Retro Soda Fountain Cookies Master Plan; base batch = 24 cookies.)

recipes.name: Egg Cream Pop Rock Wafer Sandwiches
recipes.book: Custom (wafer after King Arthur-style chocolate wafers)
recipes.notes: Crisp chocolate wafers sandwiching a milky "egg cream" creme with popping candy. WAFERS: cream butter + sugar, beat in milk + vanilla, mix in dry. Roll 1/16 in. thin between parchment, chill 30 min, cut 2 in. rounds (48 wafers). Bake at 325°F about 14 min until dry and fully crisp; they crisp more as they cool. CREME: beat shortening, powdered sugar, milk powder, vanilla and salt until fluffy. It is water-free on purpose so the popping candy keeps its pop. Fold in popping candy last, pipe about 13 g per sandwich and sandwich gently without squishing. Assemble 1-2 days before packing and store airtight. (Retro Soda Fountain 2026; base batch = 24.)

recipes.name: Black & White Malted Brownie Cookies
recipes.notes: Vanilla + chocolate (no white chocolate). CHOCOLATE half: melt chocolate with butter; whip eggs and sugars on high about 5 min to a pale ribbon for the crackly top; fold in chocolate, then dry. VANILLA half: melt the butter; whip egg, both sugars and vanilla bean paste to a pale ribbon; fold in butter, then flour, malted milk powder, baking powder and salt. The extra butter, sugar and malt stand in for the white chocolate that used to give this half its body. Chill both doughs 20 min; scoop half of each into one ball for a marbled black-and-white drop. Bake at 350°F for 12-13 min until edges set; centers firm up as they cool. Test one sheet first: the vanilla half may spread a little more. (Retro Soda Fountain 2026; base batch = 24.)

recipes.name: Cherry Phosphate Shortbread Thumbprints
recipes.book: Your Jam Thumbprint Cookies (flavor ideas from Art of Drink)
recipes.refrigerate: Chill shaped cookies while oven preheats
recipes.notes: Built on your proven Jam Thumbprint proportions (egg yolk only, no added liquid, no baking soda) so the wells hold. Cream butter, sugar and honey; beat in yolk and extracts; mix in flour, cherry powder, baking powder and salt. Roll 1 in. balls, press wells and chill shaped cookies while the oven preheats. FILLING: simmer sour cherry preserves until thick and jammy, then cool. Stir in acid phosphate and bark infusion off-heat. Fill about 1/2 tsp per cookie. Bake at 350°F for 12-13 min until edges just set. Dust with powdered sugar once cool. (Retro Soda Fountain 2026; base batch = 36.)

recipes.name: Root Beer Float Millionaire's Bars
recipes.notes: Root beer float: root beer caramel under a vanilla "ice cream" layer, with no dark chocolate. Bake pressed shortbread crust 25 min at 350°F. Cook caramel to 240°F (soft ball); off heat stir in vanilla, sarsaparilla/root beer extract and the pinch of star anise (it rounds out the extract). Pour over cooled crust and let set. TOP: melt white chocolate with vanilla bean paste and spread very thin, about 2 mm, so it reads as vanilla rather than candy. Add a few flakes of salt before it sets. Cut with a hot knife. Caramel method: https://cleverpinkpirate.com/root-beer-caramel-recipe/ (Retro Soda Fountain 2026; base batch = 24.)

recipes.name: Lime Rickey Drops
recipes.notes: Soft, cakey, tart lime cookie with a sharp sour glaze, the bright counterpoint in the box. Rub zest into sugar; cream with butter; beat in egg, sour cream, lime juice and vanilla; mix in dry. Chill 30 min. Scoop 2 Tbsp balls. Bake at 350°F for 9-11 min until just set and not browned, so they stay soft. GLAZE: whisk powdered sugar, lime juice and citric acid. Dip tops once cool and finish with fresh zest. Mixing the citric acid into the glaze keeps it from weeping and getting sticky when mailed. Optional: a tiny drop of green gel color in the glaze for Christmas green. (Retro Soda Fountain 2026; base batch = 24.)
